title: Chapter 685
text:
On the outer orbit of Planet Golden Gate, a satellite that looked like a steel fortress was orbiting around it.

This was the current headquarters of the Black Star Corps. It had been moved away from the surface of Planet Golden Gate and turned into a mobile satellite fortress. It was many times larger than before, and there were many more facilities.

Inside the satellite was the main body of the base, which was a space station like Juberly Hub. The surface was filled with defense facilities and ports.

After spending three years, Han Xiao had turned most of the bases into satellite fortresses. Although the cost was high, he was now someone who owned a mine, so he did not feel the pinch at all.

At this time, in the large port inside the base, a tall purple-haired beauty was pacing back and forth. She frequently looked in the direction of the port as if she was waiting for someone. Her hands were clasped in front of her, and her fingers were twisted together. Her beautiful face was full of nervousness and anxiety.

It was Vilna.

Ten days ago, she had listened to Aesop's orders and come to the headquarters of the Black Star Corps to wait for Han Xiao.

Today was the day that Han Xiao would return, and Vilna had come to the port early to wait. Thinking that she was about to meet the person who was said to be the person closest to Beyond Grade A in the Shattered Star Ring, she could not help but feel nervous.

Before this, Vilna had never seen Han Xiao in person, nor had she spoken to him personally. She could not help but have all kinds of thoughts about this mysterious senior.

The Black Star Corps had risen so quickly. Maybe Black Star was an ambitious schemer? She had heard that many of the organizations that he defeated had fallen into his traps. Maybe he was a schemer? Furthermore, he had a terrifying battle record that shocked the entire Star Field. Maybe he was a domineering warrior?

All kinds of thoughts flashed through Vilna's mind like fireworks. She was very nervous and rehearsed what kind of attitude she should have when meeting Black Star.

At this moment, streams of light approached from afar and appeared outside the skylight of the port. An enormous Black Star fleet appeared, slowly decelerating and entering the entrance of the satellite base.

The bottom of the battleships were embedded into the tracks, entering the base and stopping at various ports.

The flagship, on the other hand, stopped at the large dock where Vilna was. The hatch opened with a whoosh, and the air pressure pump let out a sound of deflation. The foldable gangway unfolded automatically and hung on the edge of the dock.

Draped in a black windbreaker, Han Xiao strode out in large strides. He casually looked around before stepping onto the alloy floor of the dock. The crowd behind him followed him out in a single file.

Vilna calmed herself down and jogged over, standing in front of Han Xiao.

"Your Excellency Black Star, my name is Vilna. I'm a new officer of Floating Dragon. Aesop asked me to look for you …"

Han Xiao paused and lowered his head to look at Vilna. His eyes were deep as if he was sizing her up.

Vilna's heart jumped to her throat. She swallowed. Han Xiao didn't say anything. Her brain short-circuited, and she didn't know how to answer. She fell silent and stared at each other.

After a while, Han Xiao smiled and said, "Aesop has already told me. He asked me to help you build a second Field Team. Don't worry, I'll help you."

As he spoke, Han Xiao reached out and squeezed Vilna's slender shoulders. "Since you've joined Floating Dragon, do a good job. I have high hopes for you."

Vilna's face blushed, and her tense body relaxed a little. Han Xiao's friendly attitude made her less nervous.

It seems like Black Star is a very easy person to get along with. I really don't understand why Jenny always emphasized that Black Star is a rude, unsociable, and heinous b * stard.

"Follow me."

Han Xiao snapped his fingers, turned around, and walked away. Vilna came back to her senses and hurriedly followed.

After passing through many corridors, the others said goodbye and left. Only Han Xiao and Vilna were left. The two of them walked in silence, one in front and one behind.

Han Xiao suddenly said without turning his head, "Have you met Ames? What do you think of her?"

Vilna was stunned. She thought for a while, stared at Han Xiao's back, and softly replied, "She's very gentle. I've always admired her. It's my honor to work for her."

"Hmm … does she know that your job is to build a second Field Team?"

"She should know …" Vilna thought for a while. It seemed like Ames did not ask about her job, so she added, "Aesop must have told her."

"Then, what was her attitude?"

"It seems …" Vilna thought hard and carefully said, "She didn't have any special reaction."

Han Xiao touched his chin and did not say anything.

He knew that looking for a successor was most likely Aesop's idea. Ames would not care about this kind of thing, but he did not reject it. Floating Dragon had always given him a lot of help, and he also wanted to repay Floating Dragon and leave something behind.

In order to seek better development, he chose to part on good terms, so there was no need for him to say goodbye. He did plan to train Vilna and pave the way for her, using these seven years to complete the job transfer.

Furthermore, Vilna was someone he was familiar with in his previous life. Without him, Vilna would have been the real Field Team officer of Floating Dragon.

In the end, she would have died with Floating Dragon.

All kinds of memories flashed through his mind, and the office was already in front of him. Han Xiao put away his thoughts, walked into the room with Vilna, and called Reynold, Herlous, and Sylvia.

"Let me introduce you. This is Vilna, a new officer of Floating Dragon. She's preparing to build a second Field Team, so she came to ask for my help. Help her recruit people, and don't worry about the cost. Also, choose ten financial groups from our partners and persuade them to invest in the new Floating Dragon Field Team in my name. You have to value this work and help her build a Field Team according to her ideas. Try your best to provide support."

Han Xiao said quickly. He was prepared to use the current resources and influence of the Black Star Corps to train a new team for Floating Dragon without asking for anything in return.

"Understood." Reynold nodded solemnly. He then shook Vilna's hand and said with a deep voice, "Tell me your request later. I'll try my best to fulfill it."

"Oh, oh … okay." Vilna still hadn't recovered from her shock.

Han Xiao's help was beyond her imagination. He gave her money and manpower. All she had to do was talk, and she did not have to worry about anything else. Everything was taken care of by the Black Star Corps.

He's too rich!

Vilna was dumbfounded, and a light blush appeared on her cheeks. She overturned the negative image that Jenny had instilled in her and built a new image of Han Xiao in her heart.

Friendly, steady, reliable, rich, strong, and handsome … This kind of senior is awesome!

Why is Jenny always lying to me!

Vilna was annoyed.

No wonder he could build such a huge foundation in just ten years. Although Vilna did not want to admit it, after a short time together, Han Xiao gave her the feeling that he was much more reliable than Ames.

"Then, go do your work …" Han Xiao waved his hand.

Reynold nodded and turned to the others. "Okay. Wait for me outside. I have something to talk to His Excellency Black Star alone."

Han Xiao was a bit surprised. He looked at Reynold's face and saw that he had something on his mind. Han Xiao thought for a while and nodded to the others, signaling them to leave first.

Seeing this, the others walked out with Vilna, leaving only Han Xiao and Reynold in the room.

"What do you want to talk to me about?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and stared at Reynold. Hundreds of thoughts ran through his mind.

"Actually … I didn't want to mention this because no one can help me. But now, you can help me. I have something to ask of you," Reynold said with a serious face and a sincere tone.

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He smelled the scent of a mission.

In the past few years, he had been trying to trigger a mission from Reynold, but he had never succeeded. He thought that this person did not have a mission, but now, Reynold had taken the initiative to ask, which was beyond his expectations.
